# thoth_mcp_inventory_report (Data Source)

Reads the MCP endpoint inventory report for a tenant window.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `window_hours` (Number) Report lookback window in hours. Defaults to 168.

### Read-Only

- `data_json` (String) Inventory rows as JSON array.
- `response_json` (String) Full report payload as JSON.
- `total` (Number) Total endpoint rows in the report.
- `unapproved_calls` (Number) Total unapproved MCP calls across all endpoints.
- `unapproved_endpoints` (Number) Count of endpoints with one or more unapproved MCP calls.
